source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
notes: The second suffix /–msYj/ derives attitudinal verbs with an entirely compositional meaning ‘pretend to be/act like N’ with a negative connotation. Besides semantic transparency, another argument for the syntactic status of the suffix is the possibility of its attachment to AP-NP structures.
en: Misha behaves like a dear guest at Lena’s place.
